blocks.text: The posture profile is a set of criteria evaluated on a user’s device that you can use in an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policy. You can create an Internet & SaaS posture profile for a specific trust level and add it to an app profile. To learn more about posture profiles, see About Internet & SaaS Posture Profiles.

blocks.heading: Creating an Internet & SaaS Posture Profile

blocks.text: To add an Internet & SaaS posture profile for Zscaler Client Connector:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Internet & SaaS Posture Profile.
Click Add ZIA Posture. The Add window appears.
In the Add window:
For Posture Definition, enter a Posture Name.

For High Trust, Medium Trust, Low Trust: Choose a trust level. Posture checks for all trust levels are evaluated by Zscaler Client Connector on the device and the highest matching level is used in the Internet & SaaS posture.
To define the expression:
Click the Select Device Posture drop-down menu to view a list of available postures.

Select one or more device postures for the trust level. You can search for a specific device posture and click Remove All to remove all items. Within the group, the logic is AND (i.e., the device must pass all of the selected device posture checks).

Optionally, click Add to include another group of one or more device postures and repeat the first two steps. Between the groups, the logic is OR (i.e., posture checks are evaluated starting with the first group until the device passes all of the selected device posture checks in a group).
You can add a total of 5 groups. Contact Zscaler Support to increase the limit to 15.
Review your expression in the Expression Preview field.
Click Save.

blocks.heading: Assign an Internet & SaaS Posture Profile to an App Profile

blocks.text: Posture profiles are evaluated on devices assigned to app profiles. To add an Internet & SaaS posture profile to an existing or new app profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > <OS>.
On the App Profiles tab, select one of the following:
Select an existing policy and click Edit.
Click Add <OS> Policy to create a new policy.
In the ZIA Posture Profile drop-down menu, select the Internet & SaaS posture profile you created.
When finished, do one of the following:
Click Save if you're editing an existing policy.
Click Add if you're creating a new policy.
